# identity.SessionSummary

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An active web or desktop session of the signed-in user (GET /v1/me/sessions).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `identity.SessionSummary` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the session was created (UTC). |  |
| `current` | yes | `none` | True for the session whose exchange minted the calling token. |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | When the session expires (UTC). |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Session id. |  |
| `kind` | yes | `none` | `web` (session cookie) or `desktop` (session secret). |  |
| `lastSeenAt` | yes | `none` | Last exchange or request seen for the session (UTC). |  |
| `mfa` | yes | `none` | Whether the sign-in that created the session used a second factor. |  |
| `userAgent` | yes | `personal` | Browser and OS family only, e.g. `Firefox on Windows`. |  |

_None._
